name: Sentient OS
long_description:
Sentient OS (YC F26) is the personal agent with zero inference cost.

Personal agents are the hottest thing in AI right now, but they're unsustainably expensive to run (Elon just said so about Grok Bot). Sentient runs entirely on your own chip instead, so it's free and private.

Every night, Sentient's on-device models process your emails, messages, Granola transcripts, files, and more, building a rich personal knowledge base that lives only on your Mac. Our custom inference stack runs on Macs with just 8 GB of RAM.

Your projects, conversations, commitments, and preferences. Context you'd never have the time to type into a chatbot.

That understanding powers three ways to get work done:

Sidekick: touch your Mac's notch and say "finish this for me." It gets to work across your apps and browser with its own cursor, while you keep working.

Proactive intelligence: wake up to work already prepared. The reply you forgot, drafted. The subscription renewing tomorrow, caught. Sentient waits for your approval before acting.

Double Tap: two taps, two seconds, and the reply you would have written appears, in your writing style. Just review and send.

We've grown over 10x in the last month since our YC launch; and we were top post of the month on r/MacApps.

People at over 200 companies, including Adobe, Cisco, Docusign, and Deloitte, found Sentient and connected their work emails themselves, without us ever getting on a sales call.

We've raised over $1 million from Y Combinator, Afore, Pioneer Fund, 500 Global, and a16z's Scout Fund.

Get Sentient -> sentient-os.ai
one_liner: The personal agent with zero inference cost.
